placement.reason: Development-packet monitoring of a running LFM3 DiLoCo stage (LFM3_COMMITTED_DECISIONS #15, monitoring only): pulls the global and EMA versions over the coordinator API every N rounds, converts them to GGUF and runs dev packet v2 on the prebuilt llama.cpp-neuralese server. Restored from the stage's seed snapshot (parent, base, cached code/wheelhouse), so nothing large crosses the DGX uplink. Stopped with the stage.

resource_notes: One GPU plus a RAM minimum: export-global holds the FP32 global (~6.8 GB) and a BF16 model on CPU; the GGUF conversion holds an FP32 HF copy (~6.8 GB). 48Gi.
bundle_plan: bundle.py plan --code-sha SHA --prebuilt llama-cpp-neuralese-sm120 --prebuilt wheelhouse --prebuilt ts-host --extra runs/natlang-dev-task-packet-v2-20261028 --extra <absolute .development-source-snapshots/llama.cpp-85a2e716> -o BUNDLE.json (code and wheelhouse are linked from the restored volume's content store)
